CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Introduction to Creative Arts and Sports.

3. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

6. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)

   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)

   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
